sources.title: Piracy monthly report July 2025
sources.text: The duty crew on routine rounds, onboard a tanker underway, spotted six unauthorised persons near the stern. Alarm raised, resulting in the Ship's General alarm sounded. Upon hearing the alarm, the persons escaped without stealing anything. The incident was reported to the Singaporean Authorities. All crew are reported safe.
